facts.summary: Enrollment and dosing paused after DSMB recommendation · Phase 2b/3 · bexotegrast in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: the Company has voluntarily paused enrollment and dosing in the ongoing BEACON-IPF Phase 2b trial of bexotegrast in patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF)
evidence.safety: Enrollment and dosing have been paused while data is reviewed to understand the DSMB’s rationale for their recommendation.
evidence.program_discontinued: Patients currently enrolled in BEACON-IPF will remain in the trial.
